dimensions.description: The longitudinal (front to back/rear) position to where the opponent placed their shot, thus to where the player has to move and from where the player has to play the shot.

values.description: front third of the court, usually from net back to around the service line
middle third of the court, usually from around the service line back to around or somewhat in front of the first back line (doubles service back line)
last (back) third of the court usually from around or somewhat in front of the first back line to the last back line (singles service back line)

dimensions.description: The lateral (side to side) position where the player receives and plays the shot from.

values.description: shot played from the backhand side of the player
shot played from the forehand side of the player
shot played from the middle/center position

dimensions.description: The timing of when the shot is played relative to the optimal contact point.

values.description: shot played before the optimal contact point
shot played at the optimal contact point
shot played after the optimal contact point

dimensions.description: The tactical intention or purpose behind the shot being played.

values.description: shot played with attacking intent to put pressure on opponent
shot played to maintain rally or position
shot played to defend or recover from a difficult position

dimensions.description: The type of badminton stroke or shot technique used.

values.description: A shot hit deep to the opponent's back boundary line
A shot hit softly and with finesse to fall rapidly and close to the net on the opponent's side
A hard-hit overhead shot that forces the shuttle sharply downward; badminton's primary attacking stroke
A smash hit with less power and at a flatter angle
A fast and low shot that makes a horizontal flight over the net
An offensive shot played by pushing the shuttle with a controlled motion, usually from net to the opponent's midcourt or body
Fast, downward shot that cannot be returned; a 'putaway'

dimensions.description: The type of contact made with the shuttle at impact.

values.description: full, clean contact with the shuttle
contact that imparts top-spin rotation to the shuttle
contact that imparts back-spin rotation to the shuttle
contact that cuts across the shuttle creating slice effect
contact that cuts across the shuttle in reverse direction

dimensions.description: The direction or target area where the shot is aimed.

values.description: shot played straight down the line
shot played diagonally across the court
shot played towards the center of the court
